detail.liveTestRequiresSaveHint: Save the provider first to run a live login test.
detail.liveTestError: The live login test could not be started.
detail.clientIdHelp: The OAuth2 client ID registered with your identity provider for this application.
detail.clientSecretHelp: The OAuth2 client secret for this client. Stored encrypted and never shown again after saving — leave empty to keep the stored secret.
detail.clientSecretStoredPlaceholder: Stored — leave empty to keep (re-enter after changing endpoint URLs)
detail.wellKnownConfigUrlHelp: Your IdP's OpenID Connect discovery document (…/.well-known/openid-configuration). Use "Load configuration" below to fill in the endpoint fields automatically.
detail.authorizeEndpointHelp: The IdP's authorization endpoint the customer or admin is redirected to at the start of login.
detail.accessTokenEndpointHelp: The IdP's token endpoint, used to exchange the authorization code for tokens.

tokenEndpointAuthMethod.label: Token endpoint client authentication
tokenEndpointAuthMethod.help: How the shop sends its client ID and client secret to the token endpoint. Must match the client's token_endpoint_auth_method at the IdP. Not used for public clients.

detail.userInfoEndpointHelp: The IdP's userinfo endpoint, queried for additional claims after token exchange. Optional — leave blank if your IdP puts everything needed into the ID token.
detail.jwksEndpointHelp: The IdP's JSON Web Key Set endpoint, used to verify the ID token's signature.

logoutStyle.label: Logout style
logoutStyle.help: How the user is sent to the end-session endpoint. Standard: OIDC RP-Initiated Logout (id_token_hint, client_id, post_logout_redirect_uri, state), for Keycloak, Auth0, Okta, Entra ID, Zitadel, Authentik and Authelia's OIDC logout. Authelia portal logout: Authelia's forward-auth /logout?rd=<return URL>.

detail.endSessionEndpointHelp: The IdP's end-session endpoint, used to also log the user out at the IdP on Storefront and Administration logout. Leave blank if unsupported (see the Authelia note in the documentation).
detail.revocationEndpointHelp: The IdP's token revocation endpoint (RFC 7009), used to revoke the access token on logout. Optional — a failed revocation never blocks the local logout.

revocationEndpointAuthMethod.label: Revocation endpoint client authentication
revocationEndpointAuthMethod.help: How the shop authenticates when revoking tokens. Must match the client's revocation_endpoint_auth_method at the IdP (Authelia sets it separately from token_endpoint_auth_method). Not used for public clients.

detail.issuerHelp: The exact issuer ("iss") value the IdP puts in its tokens — checked against every incoming ID token.
detail.scopeHelp: Space-separated OAuth2 scopes requested on login (default: "openid profile email").
detail.groupAttributeHelp: The claim key holding the user's group/role memberships (default: "groups"), used by the Group/Role Mapping below.
detail.pkceFlowHelp: Code challenge method used for PKCE. "S256" is preferred; use "plain" only if your IdP doesn't support S256.
detail.base64ClaimsHelp: Only for IdPs that base64-encode some claim values: list exactly those claims (a name also covers everything nested under it; * = all claims, not recommended). Other claims are never decoded.
detail.publicClientHelp: Enable for a PKCE-only client with no client secret (RFC 6749 §2.1).
detail.httpTimeoutHelp: Timeout in seconds for HTTP requests to this IdP (discovery, token exchange, userinfo, JWKS).
detail.jwksCacheTtlHelp: How long, in seconds, the fetched JWKS signing keys are cached before being re-fetched.
detail.autoCreateCustomerHelp: Automatically creates a new Storefront customer account the first time someone logs in via this provider, if no account with a matching email exists yet.
detail.autoCreateAdminHelp: Automatically creates a new Administration user account the first time someone logs in via this provider, if no account with a matching email exists yet. Creation still requires a resolvable role — see the warning below and the Default ACL role / Group mapping settings.
detail.defaultAclRoleId: Default ACL role (fallback if no group mapping matches)
detail.defaultAclRoleIdHelp: Used as a fallback Administration role when no Group/Role Mapping (further down this page) matches the user's OIDC groups.
detail.defaultCustomerGroupId: Default customer group (fallback if no group mapping matches)
detail.defaultCustomerGroupIdHelp: Used as a fallback customer group when no Group/Role Mapping (further down this page) matches the user's OIDC groups.
detail.adminProvisioningWarning: Auto-creation of Administration users is enabled, but no Default ACL role is set and no "Administration role" (or active "Grant superadmin") mapping exists. New admin logins will be refused until one of these is configured.
detail.allowSuperadminGroupMappingHelp: Required in addition to a "Grant superadmin" row in the Group/Role Mapping above — a superadmin row alone has no effect unless this is also enabled. Members of the mapped OIDC group become full Shopware superadmins, bypassing all ACL role restrictions.
detail.superadminMappingActiveWarning: "Grant superadmin" group mappings are enabled for this provider. Anyone whose OIDC groups match a "Grant superadmin" row in the Group/Role Mapping above will be given unrestricted Shopware superadmin access — make sure only trusted, tightly controlled IdP groups are mapped this way.
detail.disableNonOidcCustomerLoginHelp: Hides the username/password login form for Storefront customers, making this provider (or Passkey, if enabled) the only way to log in.
detail.disableNonOidcAdminLoginHelp: Hides the username/password login form on the Administration login screen, making this provider (or Passkey, if enabled) the only way to log in.
detail.syncCustomerProfileOnSsoHelp: Updates the customer's first name, last name, date of birth, and salutation from the identity provider's claims on every login. Only fields that are actually mapped and present in the claims are touched.
detail.syncCustomerAddressOnSsoHelp: Updates the customer's existing default billing address from the identity provider's claims on every login. Has no effect unless a billing address is mapped in the Attribute Mapping above.
detail.syncCustomerGroupOnSsoHelp: Re-evaluates the Group/Role Mapping on every login and updates the customer's group if it resolves to a different one — useful when a customer's OIDC groups change after their account was first created.
detail.syncAdminProfileOnSsoHelp: Updates the Administration user's first and last name from the identity provider's claims on every login.
detail.syncAdminRoleOnSsoHelp: Re-evaluates the Group/Role Mapping (including any superadmin grant) on every login and updates the Administration user's ACL role if it resolves to a different one.
detail.attributeMappingRequiresLiveTestHint: The claim name field only offers claims seen on a successful live login test. Run “Run live login test” above and save the provider once it succeeds to populate this list.
detail.accessControlHint: Every rule must pass (AND, in sort order) for a login to succeed; the first failing rule denies the login with its message. Claim keys use the flattened dot notation (e.g. realm_access.roles). List claims such as groups are matched by membership ("equals" = any member). "Contains" on a single value matches a whole word, never part of one — use "email domain is" to restrict by domain. "Does not equal" and "does not contain" deny when the claim is missing. Comparisons ignore case; true/1 and false/0 are treated as equal. No rules = everyone may log in.
detail.accessControlDiscoveredClaims: Claims seen on the last live test: {claims}
detail.postLogoutUrlHelp: Where the IdP sends the user after logging out there. Leave empty for the defaults (customers: the Storefront login page, admins: the Administration). For IdPs that accept only one post-logout URI, enter the shown /sw6oidc/postlogout URL and register just that one — it sends customers and admins to the right login page.
detail.healthAlertFailureThresholdHelp: A scheduled task checks this provider every 5 minutes (JWKS, else the discovery document). After this many failed checks in a row, one alert is sent per outage. 0 = alerting off.
detail.healthAlertWebhookUrlHelp: Receives a JSON POST with a human-readable "text" field (works with Slack, Mattermost, Teams workflows and most chat webhooks) plus structured details. Stored encrypted and never shown again; leave empty to keep the stored URL.
detail.healthAlertNotifyOnRecoveryHelp: Also send a message when the provider is reachable again after an alerted outage.
detail.diagnosticsAlertingOff: Off (needs a threshold above 0 and a webhook URL)
detail.diagnosticsError: Diagnostics could not be run. Please try again.

configProblem.client_secret_undecryptable: client secret cannot be decrypted (APP_SECRET changed?) — re-enter it

detail.requireEmailVerifiedHelp: Refuse logins unless the IdP sends email_verified: true for the mapped email claim. Turn off only for IdPs that never send the claim and fully control every user's email address.
detail.linkExistingAccounts: Link existing accounts by verified email
detail.linkExistingAccountsHelp: On a first SSO login, connect an existing Shopware account with the same, verified email address. Off: existing accounts must be connected explicitly from their profile ("Connect SSO"). Superadmins are never linked automatically.
detail.linkExistingAccountsUnverifiedWarning: Existing accounts are never linked with an unverified email, even with email verification not required — such users have to connect SSO from their profile.
detail.lockoutConfirmTitle: Lock out admins without single sign-on?

infrastructureWarning.redis_dsn_unusable: SW6OIDC_REDIS_DSN is set, but Redis can't be used (PHP extension missing, unreachable or authentication failing). One-time tokens are stored in the database instead — check the log for details.
infrastructureWarning.multi_node_without_redis: Several app servers handled SSO recently, but Redis isn't in use. Logins stay correct, but the rate limiter and the JWKS cache are per server unless Shopware's cache pools are shared. Set SW6OIDC_REDIS_DSN.
infrastructureWarning.redis_may_evict: The Redis used for one-time tokens may evict keys (maxmemory-policy is not noeviction). An evicted key can fail a login or let a logout token be replayed. Set maxmemory-policy to noeviction for this Redis.

detail.frontchannelAdminLogoutHelp: Front-channel logout requests are unauthenticated (only iss and sid). Administration sessions can only be ended all at once, so they are left alone by default; back-channel logout (signed) always ends them. Enable only if your IdP supports nothing but front-channel logout.
detail.revokeSuperadminOnSsoHelp: With admin role sync on: when a login's groups no longer grant superadmin, the superadmin flag is removed (the mapped ACL role remains). Never applied to the last active superadmin.

issuerChange.title: Issuer changed
issuerChange.explanation: Keep them connected if this is the same identity provider under a new URL (for example a renamed realm or domain). Disconnect them if the provider now points at a different identity provider or tenant: its users must never log into these accounts; they can connect again from their profile.

detail.superadminRequiredHint: Only a superadmin can create providers or change their security-relevant settings: endpoints, issuer, client ID, scope, public client, login type, claim handling, account linking, admin auto-creation, the default and superadmin role mappings, and the email/username mappings and access rules of providers that serve the Administration. You can change everything else.
detail.readOnlyHint: You can view this provider but not change it (missing editor permission).
detail.webhookRemovedOnSave: The stored webhook URL will be removed when you save.

sessions.hint: Every login through OIDC or a passkey, with its logout time and reason. Force logout ends a customer's OIDC session exactly; for passkey logins and for Administration users it ends all sessions of that account. Entries are deleted after the retention period (SW6OIDC_SESSION_ACTIVITY_RETENTION_DAYS, default 90 days).
